Pakistan is set to host the 14th South Asian Games from April 3 to 11, 2027.
Athletes from across the region will compete in 28 sports across Islamabad, Lahore and Peshawar.
The Games will showcase Pakistan’s sporting potential while bringing South Asia together through sport.
